SUBJECT: a TRULY ALIEN goat-sized four-legged grazer. Only the overall goat body plan survives (four legs, a compact barrel body, a long head carried forward, a pair of horns) so it still reads as a goat-like herd animal at a glance, but every surface and joint is alien: the body is armoured in overlapping ridged plates of pale, frost-white, faintly translucent crystalline chitin with glacial-blue seams; the legs are long and extra-jointed, each with a backward second knee, ending in split crystalline hooves; the horns are branching, crystal-like conductive spires; a mane of fine standing static filaments bristles along the neck and spine; six small pale eyes in two rows of three on each side of the long eyeless-looking face. MUST SHOW: (1) alien crystalline/chitinous plated hide, no fur, no wool; (2) branching lightning arcs running over the body surface; (3) extra-jointed legs; (4) still readable as a goat-shaped quadruped. NEGATIVE: not an ordinary goat, no fur coat, no brown-and-cream donor colouring, no curled ram horns, no cartoon look, no outline, no background, no ground.
